items.title: In reverse flow, India exports 500 tonnes of hilsa to Bangladesh in two months: Fish traders
items.summary: Kolkata has exported approximately 500 tonnes of hilsa fish to Bangladesh recently. Another 150 to 200 tonnes are expected to be shipped in the coming weeks. This marks a significant reversal of the traditional fish trade flow between the two nations. Bangladeshi traders are sourcing hilsa from Gujarat, which has high demand there. The fish is also being processed for export and sold domestically

items.title: Arunachal Pradesh Frontier Highway: Clearing hurdles on road to 2029 target
items.summary: India's Arunachal Frontier Highway project is now on track for construction. This strategic road aims to boost connectivity along the Chinese border. Land acquisition issues and compensation disputes have been largely resolved. The project completion deadline is set for the year 2029. This highway will facilitate rapid movement of defence forces in the region.

items.title: India's semiconductor sector draws $1.4 bn funding, half of it since 2025
items.summary: India's semiconductor sector has attracted USD 1.4 billion in all-time equity funding across 281 funded companies, with nearly half of this amount - USD 701 million - raised since 2025 alone, according to data from Tracxn.
